headline: Fed Governor Waller indicates he will support holding rates steady at September meeting
detail: Stable interest rates are generally positive for growth-oriented tech and chip stocks, as they reduce borrowing costs and make future earnings more attractive. This could provide a supportive backdrop for your portfolio.
rec: This news supports a generally positive outlook for your tech holdings, but doesn't warrant an immediate trade.

headline: Hugging Face approached Nvidia’s Huang weeks ahead of $12.9B acquisition, CEO tells CNBC
detail: This M&A news involving Nvidia highlights continued confidence and investment in the AI and chip space. It's a positive signal for the broader tech and semiconductor sector, reinforcing growth narratives.
rec: Consider NVDA as a new buy or add. Scanner entry 225.35-225.12, stop 223.39.
